_comment: Auto-approval pre-filter rules. The denylist always wins over the allowlist. Shell chaining (; && || | ` $() < >) always escalates. `disqualifying_options` lists arguments that break the promise a safe prefix makes: forcing past a safeguard (--force), widening a scoped action to the whole tree (-A, .), or making a read-only check rewrite files (--fix). `git -C <dir>` is neutralised before matching; `git -c <key>=<value>` is not, since it executes code.
